Bus stop sign

This is what the e-paper countdown sign would show at a stop. It reads the same made-up buses as the live map demo. Read the write-up.

This demo needs JavaScript turned on.

Everything in this demo is made up, and nothing you type is saved or sent anywhere. The real sign is still a prototype. This page shows the idea, not the finished hardware.
